name: Caterpillar - Decatur IL Plant
type: Manufacturing plant (mining trucks, large wheel loaders, motor graders)

fieldNotes.location: Roster point (39.8563,-88.9169) landed on a rail yard ~2.3 km SSW. Resolved the true plant to 39.8788,-88.9100 - the large multi-building Caterpillar manufacturing campus at N 27th St & E Pershing Rd, confirmed by web (TruckMap 3000 N 27th St) and satellite (test-track oval, mining-truck staging rows, ~3M sq ft footprint).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Continuous slatted chain-link perimeter fence around the whole campus confirmed in Street View on the west road. Truck access via a wide entrance driveway at the SW corner (~39.8748,-88.9158) feeding a long internal road; gate/checkpoint is set deep inside the property, not visible from the public road.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible from the public road - the checkpoint sits well inside the fence line. Classified remoteGs given a controlled fenced campus with an internal/deep checkpoint and no road-visible booth; low confidence.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: SW entrance driveway runs several hundred feet from N 27th St to the plant interior - ample queue depth for 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~22 dock doors estimated across the central building's E face and the north building; many obscured by trailers and by laydown material.
fieldNotes.dropArea: North drop yard holds 30+ trailers (multiple carriers - Meijer, MHS, McElroy visible in Street View); plus a second trailer cluster near the east dock face.
fieldNotes.railServed: Extensive rail yard along the south boundary with multiple spurs running into the property and material/laydown alongside.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus of 9+ distinct large manufacturing/assembly buildings plus a test-track oval.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified; the deep internal layout could contain one not resolvable from imagery.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~360 acres for the fenced campus including staging and rail - approximate from the perimeter box.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-Decatur industrial setting bordered by farmland east and a residential subdivision north - classified Rural per the small-town/edge-of-town rule.

citations.claim: Active Caterpillar job openings in Decatur, IL as of May 2026, confirming ongoing CAT-operated production.
Caterpillar makes its largest mining truck (797F) in Decatur and nowhere else.

verification.rationale: CAT-operated mining-truck/wheel-loader/grader plant; current CAT careers reqs, no sale/closure (only temporary layoffs).
